entries.description: Generated post-rebuild-uat-checklist.json with 29 items across 9 functional areas: Shell and Navigation, Dashboard, Products, Retail Businesses, Orders, Reports, Admin, Authentication, Cross-Cutting Quality. Each item includes HumanAction, Expectation, and Other rows for open-ended feedback.

Created Dev Quick Sign-In feature on the login page: dropdown of 6 test personas with JS interop to call the seeded-session endpoint. Gated by SeededSession.Enabled config. Files: Login.razor, dev-quick-signin.js.

Human executed the full UAT checklist. Results: 13 passed, 16 failed. Key findings: content hidden behind app bar (systemic), dashboard search discards input, product filter panel issues, Undo button disabled, reports no data, user management inaccessible for org-scoped admins, currency/date alignment, Security Dashboard duplicate headers and empty tabs.

Layout and styling fixes: (1) Added pt-16 to MudMainContent for app bar offset, (2) right-aligned currency/date columns with max-width:130px, (3) added Bordered=true to all 7 MudDataGrid instances, (4) removed duplicate h1 header from DabblerSecurityDashboard.razor.

Functional bug fixes: (1) Product Detail Undo — added ValueChanged callbacks to 5 fields missing dirty-state tracking, (2) Dashboard search — pass search term as query param, added InitialSearchTerm parameter to list components, (3) Report date pickers — added Editable=true with DateFormat and Placeholder, (4) Admin visibility — isAdmin check now considers org-scoped BackofficeUserAdmin across all memberships.
Spread report columns to full landscape width (9.5") in both orders-by-customer.rdf.json and sales-by-product.rdf.json. Previous layout used only ~6" of available width.

Added 5 lessons learned: UAT checklists need explicit test data, navigation must pass user input, fixed app bars need content offset, ValueChanged callbacks must cover all fields, currency/date columns should be right-aligned. Updated guiding-principles.md with grid styling convention.
